newsitem.title: USA: Camco operating profit grew faster than revs.
newsitem.headline: Camco operating profit grew faster than revs.

text.p: Camco International Inc said on Tuesday that all four of its operating groups reported revenue growth of at least 20 percent during the second quarter, and all four had their operating profit grow at a faster rate than revenues.
But net income per share for the quarter remained flat at $0.41 due to a one-time, $12.5 million charge from the acquisition of Productions Operators Corp, the company said in a news release.
Camco said that its Production Operators group revenues grew 30 percent, followed closely by its Reda group.
The Camco Drilling and Camco Products groups each had revenue growth greater than 20 percent.

Camco's overall revenues for the quarter were $227.1 million, up from $185.3 million for the same period a year ago. Operating net revenues for the quarter, excluding merger expenses, were $0.64 per share, compared with $0.41 per share for the year-ago period.
Camco is an oilfield equipment and services company.
